'''Darkcloud Pinnacle''' is a [[village]] of the [[Grimtotem clan]] of [[tauren]] and located atop the pinnacles in the central area of the [[Thousand Needles]]. It is here that a secret correspondence between Grimtotem leaders and an unknown dark power takes place. The leaders of the Grimtotems here are [[Arnak Grimtotem]] and [[Harb Foulmountain]]. The entry path from the base begins at {{coords|31.3|37|Thousand Needles}}.
